# QnALog 1.6.6

## Highlights

- The sidebar panel, ribbon tooltip and open command are now named "QnALog voice notes" (QnALog 语音笔记) instead of the minutes wording.
- Interface wording: "minutes" (纪要) now reads "notes" (笔记) wherever it refers to a single note or the list of notes. The default folder name, existing file name prefixes and organizing-type names are unchanged.
- Plugin metadata no longer shows up in the note body. Session data, the index block and version-region markers are hidden or kept inside collapsed sections, and the index data is the last item under "Original material".
- Long notes fold on open. The raw transcript is split into one collapsed section per segment, and the large transcript data is stored in a hidden element instead of inside the collapsed section. Before this, a 15-minute note stayed expanded until the window was scrolled to the end.
- Re-organizing or switching versions upgrades the "Original material" section of an older note to this layout. Notes you do not touch are not modified.
- Generated tags drop characters Obsidian does not allow (for example `&` and spaces), so `Q&A` becomes `QA` and shows up as a normal tag.
- Fixed importing a long audio file where one transcript segment exceeded about 3,500 characters.

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. Existing notes are not rewritten until you re-organize or append to them. New and rewritten notes keep per-segment transcript data in a hidden element, which 1.6.5 and earlier do not read; downgrading would leave those notes readable but without per-segment transcript data. Topic pages and the Topics tab are unchanged.
